items.detail: The **S&P 500** jumped 1.31% to 7,619.38 Wednesday and the Nasdaq rose 1.60% to 25,466.19, more than recovering Tuesday's inflation-driven dip.
items.why: CoreWeave soared about 25% on a raised revenue outlook, reviving confidence in AI spending.

items.detail: **Nvidia** closed up 2.87% at $173.73, then sank more than 8% after hours to about $159.51, dragging US futures lower.
items.why: The Wall Street Journal reported the board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, and directors met late Wednesday.

items.detail: Taiwan's **Taiex** fell 2.63% to 43,091.87 Thursday, the worst major market in Asia, with TSMC down 2.3%, while Japan's Nikkei lost 0.7%.
items.why: Reports that Nvidia may oust its CEO hit the chip and AI hardware stocks that supply it.

items.detail: The Sensex closed Wednesday up 773 points at 81,879.40 and the **Nifty** rose 0.84% to 25,255.05, its highest close in nearly nine months. Both edged higher early Thursday.
items.why: Foreign investors kept buying, crude oil stayed soft and September-quarter results beat forecasts.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** rose 0.88% to 2,846.26 Wednesday, more than reversing Tuesday's drop but trailing the Nasdaq.
items.why: CoreWeave's strong outlook lifted AI and tech names across the market, including smaller companies.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** stayed stuck near $73,640 early Thursday and missed out on Wednesday's stock rally.
items.why: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $299.9 million Wednesday, their fifth straight day of outflows, led by BlackRock's IBIT.

items.detail: **Ether** held around $2,060, down about 11% over the past week and just above the $2,000 level.
items.why: Ether ETFs lost $145 million Wednesday, their fifth straight day of outflows, bringing November withdrawals near $700 million.

items.detail: **Solana** slipped to about $83, down nearly 12% over seven days.
items.why: Solana ETFs had $5.85 million of outflows Wednesday, extending weeks of withdrawals.

items.detail: **Gold** fell back below $4,000 Wednesday to about $3,984, down 1.2%, after losing nearly 4% over two days.
items.why: High Treasury yields after the hot inflation report increased bets on a December Fed hike.

crossCuttingTheme: Nvidia's leadership crisis is now the main market driver: its after-hours drop hit Taiwan's chipmakers and US futures. Separately, December rate-hike bets keep pressure on gold and crypto, while cheaper oil supports India.
